caption: The drawing consists of two distinct painted objects reproduced on a plain light beige background. The top object is an oval shape featuring a central figure of a woman with light skin and dark hair, wearing a brown, patterned dress with a white collar and cuffs, and holding a stringed musical instrument, possibly a lute or guitar, across her lap. She is seated outdoors on green grass with two tall green leafy trees behind her, and a blue sky visible above. This vignette is enclosed with a red border bearing an inscription in a decorative, stylized script painted in tones of yellow and cream around the upper and lower portions of the oval. Below this, there is a rectangular strip bordered in blue, with the interior decorated with a scrolling floral pattern in shades of blue, red, orange, cream, and green against a wood-look background. Stems and leaves intertwine with blooms, forming a continuous horizontal band. At the bottom of the drawing is the notation “Scale = 2/3 Full Size” and the artist’s name, “Elmer G. Anderson.”
title: Pa. German Bandbox
